## 2025-02-14 - Accessible Input Association and Multi-step Control
**Learning:** Reusable input fields (e.g., `<Input>` and `<Textarea>`) without proper htmlFor and id bindings cause screen readers to fail to associate labels with interactive fields. Additionally, wrap-style label components surrounding non-interactive texts (such as step titles) mixed with interactive button groups are non-semantic and break accessibility.
**Action:** Always employ React's `useId` hook to generate deterministic, unique auto-generated IDs inside reusable form controls to associate `<label>` elements with `<input>`/`<textarea>`. Represent option sets (such as booking time slots) using standard HTML lists or grids with `role="group"` and `aria-label` containers instead of invalid label wrappers, and provide clear semantic states on options using `aria-pressed`.
